resources.string: Qwen3-ASR runs entirely on this device. The bundled model needs about 1 GB of additional storage and recognition uses about 2.4 GB of memory. Prepare the model and allow microphone access, then choose Offline voice input under Space long press behavior. Hold space to speak; release to finish.
Ready. Choose Offline voice input under Space long press behavior.
Microphone access is required. Tap to try again, or allow it in Android app settings.

Open Keyboard settings → Prepare offline voice input first.
Offline voice input requires an ARM64 device.
